$comment: HIMMEL-2302: per-cadence wizard registry — one row per cadence UNIT (script-level granularity) the install wizard can offer to arm. bin.js's askCadences()/CADENCE_REGISTRY enumerate from this file; the menu is never a hardcoded list in bin.js. `script` is a repo-root-relative path to a cmd_arm()/cmd_status()/cmd_disarm() cadence script (test-wizard-cadence-registry.sh's staleness lint asserts both facts for every row). `requires`: 'vault' rows are only offered when vault!=='none'; 'lane:codex' rows are only offered when 'codex' is in the final lanes selection; 'env:<KEY>' rows (HIMMEL-3068) are only offered when <KEY> is set in the primary checkout's .env (bin.js's offeredCadenceRows(), readEnvVarFile()) — filtered out otherwise in every case, so the answer stays genuinely undefined — never fabricated. `recommended` is a static per-row signal (today: only pipeline) — the wizard's actual per-run pre-selected default comes from PROFILE_PRESETS[profile].cadenceIds in bin.js, not from this flag. scripts/graphify/ggs-cadence.sh is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from this registry — it is operator-personal hardware (a Spider Farmer GGS BLE controller cadence), not a general installer surface. scripts/graphify/graph-cadence.sh (HIMMEL-2095) is ALSO deliberately excluded as its own row — it has no cmd_arm of its own (a plain runner leg, not a cadence controller); arming 'graphmap' already arms it unconditionally as a fifth task (see graphmap-cadence.sh's TASK_PUBLISH_HIMMEL), so a separate row would let an operator arm something with no independent effect.

cadences.label: luna pipeline
cadences.description: daily fetch-health/harvest/synthesize + weekly health runs against the vault (HIMMEL-255/357/798/1449)

cadences.label: qmd reindex
cadences.description: daily qmd update+embed+completeness assert over every configured collection (HIMMEL-568)

cadences.label: graphify graph refresh
cadences.description: hourly free structural (AST) refresh + weekly semantic refresh of the luna/himmel graphify graphs, PLUS a standalone 6-hourly refresh+publish+auto-merge-PR task for himmel's own graph (HIMMEL-829/2095)

cadences.label: codex orphan sweep
cadences.description: recurring sweep of orphaned codex broker/MCP-fleet processes (HIMMEL-892)

cadences.label: upstream drift-fix
cadences.description: nightly /drift-fix (bump auto-bumpable pins, open an ordinary PR) + /fork-resync (rebase carried forks, audit-only) — stops at the PR/audit, never merges (HIMMEL-1323)

cadences.label: upstream PR/issue watch
cadences.description: daily scan of himmel's open upstream PRs/issues for a delta — no claude session, Telegram-notified only when something changed (HIMMEL-2367)

cadences.label: repo sync + stale-worktree cleanup
cadences.description: daily fetch + fast-forward-only pull of every git repo under --github-root/--documents-root, plus a stale scratch-worktree cleanup pass (HIMMEL-2115/2116). Windows-only (schtasks; no crontab arm path)

cadences.label: Google Health vitals pull
cadences.description: daily Google Health connector pull to a review artifact — no claude session; only offered once GOOGLE_HEALTH_REFRESH_TOKEN is configured (docs/luna/google-health-connector-setup.md) (HIMMEL-3068)
